Adobe expects clicks from AI services to US retail sites to rise 130% this holiday season. The assistants are the same ones British shoppers use, and Black Friday falls on 27 November here too.

Our view is that UK retail and DTC brands should treat AI referrals as a named channel in this year's peak trading report, with its own baseline and targets set on conversion and returns rather than volume.

The baseline is the job to hand over. Give your AI a referral export for September and October and it picks out visits from the main assistants, gives you a weekly baseline and writes the matching rule for your analytics team.

clips.text: Say a shopper asks an assistant to compare three running jackets under a hundred and fifty pounds. The assistant reads product pages, reviews and retailer listings, then sends the click to whichever page answered best. Thin descriptions, sizing hidden in an image, a price that loads late, all of that gives it less to quote. So the product catalogue is now doing part of the job a comparison site or a paid search ad used to do. That's the shift, yes. Our view at Manual Focus is that UK retail and direct-to-consumer brands should treat AI referrals as a named channel in this year's peak trading report. Its own baseline, its own targets, even while the numbers are small. And I'd set those targets on conversion and returns rather than volume.
